## Python Crash Course Video Production Kanban

- [ ] Open this file in Obsidian with the **Kanban** community plugin enabled. Drag a complete card between stage columns; Obsidian edits this same Markdown file.
- [ ] Keep each milestone field current as information becomes available. Do not guess recording dates, edit dates, Panopto IDs, or course-notes paths.
- [ ] After recording, the IT Multimedia team retrieves footage directly and handles filenames. There is no manual footage handoff to create or track.
- [ ] When an edited cut arrives, move its card to **Instructor review and approval**. If revisions are requested, move it to **Multimedia revision requested**; move it back to **Instructor review and approval** when the revised cut arrives.
- [ ] After approval, wait for the stable Panopto ID. Add a course-notes link only after the actual ID and notes location are known, then verify the relevant built course output before marking the card complete.
